info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Product Matching-spec
info.description: The Sale Product Matching API enables businesses to efficiently identify and match products during the sales process. Designed for use by sales teams and e-commerce platforms, this API streamlines the process of associating products with sales transactions. By harnessing this API, developers can implement features that enhance sales workflows, improving accuracy and speed. Typical use cases include integrating product matching capabilities into sales applications and automating product selection based on various criteria.

post.description: This operation creates a product matching entry that helps identify similar products based on defined criteria. Utilize this endpoint to enhance your product recommendations and improve customer experience.
